name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted newsletter, email marketing and transactional email platform with a visual MJML editor, automations and a PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deployment to finish the setup wizard: whoever reaches it first sets the root administrator email. A working SMTP server is required, since sign-in codes are sent by email.
SECRET_KEY encrypts the provider credentials stored in the database. Keep it with your database backups: without it the stored settings cannot be read.
